newsitem.title: IRAN: Quake jolts western Iran, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts western Iran, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake jolted the vicinity of Ardel in western Iran, but reports of casualties or damage were not immediatly available, the state-run news agency IRNA said on Monday.
The agency said the quake, measuring 4.2 degrees on the open-ended Richter scale -- enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area -- occured at 6.30 am local time (0300 GMT).
Quakes hit Iran regularly. The worst recorded one, measuring 7.3 on the Richter scale, killed 35,000 people in a densely populated region near the Caspian coast in 1990.
